content: Dexie.js is the 2026 default IndexedDB wrapper (typed tables, indexed queries, transactions, schema versioning, react hooks). Critical rule from Dexie maintainer: store large Blobs directly but NEVER index binary/base64 data (no gain, bloats index). Store imageData:Blob unindexed, index only a hash/id. Browser quota generous (Chrome up to ~80% disk, Firefox ~2GB cap historically). Use navigator.storage.estimate() to monitor, navigator.storage.persist() to avoid eviction. Compression Streams API available for shrinking blobs.
